p: Okay. Why are the NYPD’s public relations expenditures a prudent use of police time and resources?

Well, I do think it’s actually very important for the Department to get its message out there. We are a very important stakeholder in the criminal justice system, and obviously there are a variety of perspectives out there, but the Department’s perspective on matters related to public safety is, I think, an important voice in the room so to speak. And getting our message out there we do it in a variety ways, and you know, maybe a decade ago this would have been done via press conference or via an interview, but in 2024 one very important way to communicate with the public is via social media, and that’s something that we’ve done and will continue to do.

It is essential and imperative that there is no harm done to innocent folks out there who are just doing their jobs, like I said, appropriately and accurately.
